subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should the focused workspace breadcrumb in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95346 close this broader multi-agent safety request, or should optional switcher/color/message-prefix/session-proof ideas remain tracked separately?
rationale: Current main still lacks workspace context, but the linked PR intentionally solves the narrow safety indicator while leaving optional UX and deeper live-session proof ideas out of scope.

options.title: Land focused breadcrumb and split optional UX
options.body: Rebase/review the linked PR, close this issue when it lands, and open or leave separate follow-up only for optional controls maintainers still want.

options.title: Expand before closure
options.body: Require the linked PR or a replacement to include more of the optional switch feedback, quick switcher, or session-proof behavior before this issue can close.

options.title: Keep as umbrella after merge
options.body: Land the focused PR but keep this issue open as a broader multi-agent Dashboard context umbrella, accepting that it will remain product-scope work.

recommendation.title: Land focused breadcrumb and split optional UX
recommendation.body: Rebase/review the linked PR, close this issue when it lands, and open or leave separate follow-up only for optional controls maintainers still want.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-line ownership and timeline involvement make steipete the best available routing candidate for the closure-scope decision.
